title: Napoleon Lost A Fight To An Army Of Rabbits
description: AI-narrated commentary revisiting the bizarre true story of Napoleon's disastrous 1807 rabbit hunt, when the animals he was supposed to shoot charged straight at him instead.

hook_candidates.text: Napoleon once lost a battle to rabbits.
What actually made Napoleon retreat from a hunting trip?
Napoleon wasn't undefeated after all, thanks to a field of rabbits.
Three things Napoleon never expected to lose to: weather, terrain, and rabbits.

share_trigger: a viewer sends this to their friend who insists Napoleon never lost a single fight in his entire life
contradicted_belief: Most people assume Napoleon never lost a real battle in his entire life.
closing_comment: If you think Napoleon lost a fight to an army of angry rabbits sounds made up, it's real recorded history.

beats.text: Napoleon once lost a battle to **rabbits**.
beats.broll_query: Napoleon in military uniform recoiling from a swarm of rabbits, dramatic outdoor scene

beats.text: In 1807 he organized a **hunt** he was certain he'd win.
beats.broll_query: 18th century French hunting party with rifles gathered in a field, formal military dress

beats.text: His staff rounded up **thousands** of rabbits for him to shoot.
beats.broll_query: wooden crates full of live rabbits being unloaded in a countryside field

beats.text: Nobody thought to ask the rabbits if they'd agreed to that.
beats.broll_query: cartoon-style rabbit looking directly at camera with a mischievous grin, closeup

beats.text: Those rabbits weren't wild, they were **farm-raised** and totally tame.
beats.broll_query: domesticated rabbits being fed by hand inside a wooden farm hutch

beats.text: Tame rabbits see a human and think **one** thing: food is coming.
beats.broll_query: close-up of a rabbit's nose twitching eagerly near an outstretched human hand

beats.text: Napoleon just became lunch, wearing an extremely fancy hat.
beats.broll_query: ornate bicorne hat sitting on the ground surrounded by curious rabbits, comedic angle

beats.text: When released, thousands of rabbits **charged** straight at Napoleon instead of running away.
beats.broll_query: large group of rabbits running in one direction across an open field toward camera

beats.text: His own men couldn't beat them back fast enough with sticks.
beats.broll_query: soldiers in period uniform waving sticks frantically at ground level, chaotic scene

beats.text: The emperor of Europe, defeated by lunch on legs.
beats.broll_query: silhouette of a defeated military officer sitting slumped on the ground at dusk

beats.text: Napoleon actually had to retreat before the rabbits reached his carriage.
beats.broll_query: ornate 19th century carriage pulling away quickly across a grassy field, motion blur

beats.text: Historians still debate the exact rabbit count, some say **thousands**, others say hundreds.
beats.broll_query: old sepia-toned history book open to a page with illustrations, magnifying glass on top
old parchment map of European battle campaigns being rolled up by hand, warm lighting
